Synopsis

This is the life story of a girl raised in an orphanage—known as "Xiao Yu" or "Si Zhuoer"…

Born into hardship, she struggled on the fringes of society, lost in despair—until the day her bleak existence was torn open by a Xianzhe.

Xianzhe walk the earth, guiding Shengren. She encountered Pinde, the golden-haired "Xianzhe of the Heart", who carved her sorrow into a singular virtue: the power to "Fangwu Wanwu", an omnipotent yet not omniscient force capable of replicating and manifesting anything.

Raised, Named, and Sent Off.

At Furuizi’s behest, she became the one who judges the Saints—"Shengshenzhe".

In the long, bitter journey ahead, she will meet different shengren and bear witness to their tragedies.

"And so their deeds were carved into stone, erected upon their graves."

About this game

《Shengshenzhe》is a visual novel game that tells the story of the first half of the life of an orphaned young woman, "Xiaoyu" or "Si Zhuoer". The narrative follows her as she explores friendships, love, and familial bonds while encountering various Shengren. This work is a linear visual novel with no branches or choices.

The outline is complete, the ending is determined, it will not be discontinued abruptly, and it is currently serialized. You are welcome to follow along for updates.

short_description: It follows Xiao Yu—a lonely orphan girl who, in her darkest hour, encounters a mysterious golden-haired woman. Under her tutelage, Xiao Yu awakens as a Shengren... only to be entrusted with a solemn duty: to pass judgment on fallen Shengren who have strayed from grace.
